name: gaps2-harrow-round
description: L1Z1X Harrow (audit-gaps-2, gate TI4_RULES_FACTIONS / rulesGateFactions). Card text: 'At the end of each round of ground combat, your ships in the active system may use their BOMBARDMENT abilities against your opponent's units on the planet.' Factions round 2 offered it on the ground-combat round prompt with the timing and once-per-round left to the player. pbd104@44 (ground combat on Tarmann, 210): Harrow before the round is rolled is refused; after both sides roll round 1 it is accepted; a second Harrow in the same round is refused. (The 1% case where L1Z1X rolls no hit leaves no hit prompt for Xxcha and the scenario must be rerun.)
